It must be remembered that the winning team each year is barred from again competing and so the necessity of finding new blood is apparent. In this, the first post-war championship to be held, the field was led almost from the start by R.

The "Senior" produced another convincing win by Frank Aaron from Alec Olney, Reg. Gosney and Harry Hicks, with the team title going again to the excellent packing of the Northern Champions Sutton Harriers whose first five scorers were home in twentyfive places!
